title: Employment contracts
definition: The contract of employment between the customer and a third party, showing the role, the remuneration and the term. It is requested where a stated source of income depends on a role that the customer has not otherwise evidenced, and it establishes the relationship and its terms.
evidence_to_cite: the contract, with its date and the parties
the remuneration terms and the commencement date

sources.citation: Evidence of a stated source of income, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
